title: Repair canonical review publication and exact-version GitHub gate

owned: Exact Git target commit validation in canonical_review_gate_ci.py via bounded tag peeling (up to depth 5), rejecting mismatched commits, non-commit objects, and malformed tags; introduces 5-state TagInspection distinguishing confirmed absence from malformed/mismatched/api_error and failing closed.
Observable workflow_dispatch in github_review_bridge.py defaulting to required=True on both APPROVE and REOPEN decisions.
Retirement of legacy direct PAT status submission (_submit_required_status) in github_review_bridge.py and convergence of GITHUB_REVIEW_MODES to only pull_request_review across bridge and ai_status.

Intent-fenced deletion of opposing decision tags on approve, operator_accept, and reopen decisions verifying PR reviews timeline nonce ordering, preventing conflicting proof tags and rejecting stale concurrent retries.
Fail-closed evaluation in canonical_review_gate_ci.py when a reopen tag or conflicting tags exist for the target commit.

Canonical review gate reconciliation in auto_integrator.py: re-dispatching review gate workflow when TaskStore approval and GitHub proof tag are valid and reopen tag is strictly absent, recording observable failure details without claiming false re-dispatch; substantive test failures fail closed immediately.
Attestation audit workflow simplification in canonical-review-attestation-audit.yml to manual workflow_dispatch only, removing automated triggers and obsolete external issuer claims.
not_changing: TaskStore canonical approval authority, state machine, or review locks.
External signed attestation audit issuer architecture or diagnostic contracts.
No second mechanisms, queues, background daemons, or alternate approval APIs introduced.
composes_with: the existing per-task PR review/merge flow and supervisor integration runner

failure_reproduction.case_1_tag_target_commit: canonical_review_gate_ci previously checked only ref name presence, accepting tags pointing to wrong commits or non-commit objects.
failure_reproduction.case_2_swallowed_dispatch: github_review_bridge previously caught and swallowed workflow_dispatch failures when required=False, leaving PRs red without observable errors while posting conflicting PAT status.
failure_reproduction.case_3_reopen_approve_conflict: Reopening an approved candidate on the same commit left both approved and reopen tags; gate checked only approved tag and reported false green.
failure_reproduction.case_4_integrator_stagnation: auto_integrator had no way to reconcile a red/pending review gate check when TaskStore approval and GitHub proof tags were valid, causing pipeline stalls.
failure_reproduction.case_5_stale_retry_unfenced_deletion: github_review_bridge deleted opposing tags unconditionally without verifying timeline ordering, allowing stale retries to delete newer reopens.
failure_reproduction.case_6_reopen_ref_silent_collapse: canonical_review_gate_ci collapsed unreadable/malformed reopen refs and API errors to False, allowing gate approval to pass when reopen proof was ambiguous or unverified.

implementation.canonical_review_gate_ci: Implemented resolve_proof_tag_target with bounded peel depth (MAX_TAG_PEEL_DEPTH=5) verifying target commit against head_sha. Introduced TagInspection with 5 distinct states: confirmed_absent, valid, mismatched, malformed, and api_error. Updated build_status_payload to require confirmed absence of reopen tag before evaluating approval.
implementation.github_review_bridge: Implemented intent-fenced _delete_ref and _resolve_ref_target_commit verifying PR reviews timeline sequence. Set _dispatch_canonical_review_gate_workflow default to required=True. Retired _submit_required_status and converged GITHUB_REVIEW_MODES to only pull_request_review.
implementation.auto_integrator: Implemented is_canonical_review_gate_green and make_integrator_tag_lookup propagating non-404 API errors. Added review gate re-dispatch reconciliation for valid TaskStore approvals with valid GitHub proof tags and strictly absent reopen tags, recording dispatch failures with observable detail without claiming success.
implementation.canonical_review_attestation_audit: Simplified workflow triggers to manual workflow_dispatch only, removing automated pull_request_target, issue_comment, and schedule triggers. Updated documentation headers to reflect manual-only diagnostic posture.

review_decision.note: Ready for exact-head independent review by Codex.

runtime_activation.requires: Genuine assigned exact-head review, required checks and sole integrator merge before existing qualified runtime promotion.
